key_insight: PLUTO uses agentic AI to translate plain-language spacecraft rendezvous goals into convex-optimization-ready constraints for interactive trajectory design.
engineering_relevance: It lowers the expertise barrier for mission designers by linking natural-language intent directly to executable optimal control formulations within a sequential convex programming workflow.
method: Maps user prompts to structured mathematical constraints via an LLM-based agentic coding pipeline.
Auto-convexifies the extracted constraints and injects them into an SCP trajectory optimizer.
Adds visual constraint verification and scenario parameterization for interactive mission design.
evidence_signal: Across 50 natural-language rendezvous prompts spanning 10 constraint types, PLUTO produced a trajectory for every prompt and 94% met both quantitative and qualitative mission requirements.
watch_item: Performance depends on correct prompt interpretation and constraint translation, so verification is still needed for safety-critical mission design.
paper_title: PLUTO: An Agentic AI Tool for Interactive Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Design
